$comment: Shared Badge bindings, used by every theme. Badge's colours already bind to semantic tokens, so a theme's token overrides reach them with no binding. These cover what Badge binds outside the semantic layer: the font stack and the corner radius at each size. Defaults: each role token starts at Spectrum's own value, so a theme lists only what it changes.

bindings.reason: Badge binds sans-font-family-stack, which a theme cannot change without changing every component. default-font-family is the role token Button already uses.
Spectrum binds corner-radius-medium-size-small, used far beyond Badge.
Type stress test: lets a theme set weight. Spectrum binds a weight token used far beyond this component.
Type stress test: Spectrum sets no letter spacing here, so this adds the property.
Type stress test: Spectrum sets no text transform here, so this adds the property.
Type stress test: font size at S. Spectrum's font-size scale is used by every component.
Type stress test: line height at S, so a bigger font does not clip.
Type stress test: font size at M. Spectrum's font-size scale is used by every component.
Type stress test: line height at M, so a bigger font does not clip.
Type stress test: font size at L. Spectrum's font-size scale is used by every component.
Type stress test: line height at L, so a bigger font does not clip.
Type stress test: font size at XL. Spectrum's font-size scale is used by every component.
Type stress test: line height at XL, so a bigger font does not clip.
